description:
Solo Participant | Hackathon Debut
​Passionate fresher eager to learn and innovate in space exploration, bringing strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills to pitch our project effectively. With a little experience in coding languages like JavaScript, CSS and HTML,Wanna build a creative and functional solution!
summary:
I developed a PPT slides in which it explains to a child/young minds about NASA's incredible missions & equipments through visual images. It narrates real incidents & addresses the challenges by providing accurate mission data withdrawn from NASA. For over half a century,humanity has sent incredible machines to moon,mars,deep space & other celestial bodies.
There's a real opportunity here to inspire the next generation using the rich,untold histories of these off-world artifacts & groundbreaking science that paved the way for today's achievements & tomorrow's exploration. 
Overall my mission is to make hard calculations into simple narration due to which people engage themselves in discussions related to space science,which should primarily start from young enthusiasts/young minds. In simple terms, It's "Science made Easy!"
details: It is a simple approach to the challenge through ppt slides. It is purely based on the data which NASA provided.
